items.title: India’s gig internet workforce may reach 17-21 million by 2030
items.whyInNews: A report by Bengaluru firm Redseer states that India's gig internet workforce is expected to grow significantly by 2030, with an estimated 17-21 million workers in the sector.
items.summary: The report highlights the growth potential of India's gig economy, with an estimated 17-21 million workers expected to be part of the sector by 2030. This growth is driven by the increasing demand for delivery, ride-hailing, and home services. The report also notes that full-time gig workers earn up to 2.5 times the monthly net income of workers in comparable formal and informal occupations.
